_why: The thinking choice words, read from both sides. backend/openrouter.py REASONING_EFFORT_ORDER and THINKING_CHOICES are the authority; backend/tests/test_thinking_effort.py holds them equal to this file, and frontend/src/lib/models/thinking.ts keeps a mirror that frontend/src/test/components/ThinkingEffort.test.tsx holds equal to it. effort_order runs from least to most thinking; off and default are the two choices that are not a level. untouched_mandatory_order is where an untouched mandatory model takes its lowest level from; max is not in it, so a model listing only max keeps the request it always had.
